note: Q4_0 here is the stock file. Cale's models/gguf/*.cale.gguf holds the same numbers with the ffn_down matrices stored as two halves (prepare_gguf.py), so stock llama.cpp cannot load it.
verdict: Perplexity shows NO damage from Q4_0 (it is lower than Q8_0 on both texts, outside the error bars). Perplexity is not a trustworthy quality measure for an instruction-tuned model, so this does not prove 4-bit is as good. Instruction check skipped: scripts/score.py only loads MLX folders. A KL-divergence run against Q8_0 needs about 2-5 GB of reference logits and does not fit the 15 GB disk floor.
